A solid nodule is seen in the medial segment of the right middle lobe (SE203, IM96), with a long diameter of approximately 3mm. A solid nodule is seen in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe (SE203, IM101), with a long diameter of approximately 3mm. Scattered linear opacities are present in the right middle lobe and lingular segment of the left upper lobe. The density of both lower lobes is heterogeneous. No abnormalities are seen in either hilar region. The visualized tracheobronchial shadows are normal. No abnormally enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum. Focal calcification of the aortic wall. A mass is present in the lower outer quadrant of the right breast, with a long diameter of approximately 20mm.
